title: 未来城市
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE finished professional SIMPLE children's coloring-book illustration, square 1024x1024, for an Android tablet coloring game ages 5–12. Expert illustrator's warm expressive organic drawing with confident flowing curves, tasteful varied line weight and charming asymmetry; never geometric clip-art parts or a diagram. Make the main character or vehicle big, around 70–80% of the image, with a memorable playful pose and one clear amusing story beat. Only 10–16 LARGE enclosed white colorable shapes across the ENTIRE picture, hard maximum 20 including the background. Keep every colorable area broad and easy for a child's finger, no tiny enclosed islands. Use expressive solid-black simple eyes WITHOUT tiny white highlights, and open smile curves; large simple facial shapes. Omit decorative texture, fur tufts, narrow stripes, dense details, screws, tiny windows, scales, grass blades, confetti and background ornaments. Add only 1–2 BIG simple secondary props that support the scene. Background nearly empty WHITE, perhaps one broad sweeping ground/cloud curve and one large simple sun/star, never a detailed scene. Crisp clean bold BLACK outlines on pure WHITE: roughly 6px outer contours and 4px interior at 1024px, continuous CLOSED boundaries, generous blank coloring areas. No gray shading, color, gradient, hatching, sketch/construction marks, paper texture, text, logo, border, or watermark. Keep main subject and appendages inside safe white margins; no cropped character. Finished professional Q-cute children's picture-book ink line art: simpler linework and fewer bigger color blocks, lively and lovable rather than mechanically assembled.

Scene: A delightfully imaginative tiny future city containing ONLY TWO broad organically curved buildings joined by ONE gracefully curving elevated walkway. One building leans gently like a friendly soft mushroom, the other has a playful sweeping curved roof; they are architecture, not mushrooms. Only TWO or THREE very large windows TOTAL and ONE broad door. The elevated walkway is one wide curved ribbon with no railing grid, no support lattice and no tiny floor markings. Add at most one broad ground curve. No skyscraper cluster, no repeated windows, no grid, no road traffic, no antennas, no panels or ornament dots. Distinct flowing hand-drawn silhouettes and an amusing neighborly composition. 10–16 broad enclosed white areas total; maximum 20 including background.

Final topology simplification: plan just 8–12 large white regions total, not a detailed city. Strictly flat ink-line art; all windows are SINGLE-outline shapes with NO rim, inset, frame, thickness or perspective edge. Use one or two broad windows per house at most, not a row of little windows. Every enclosed white area must fit a circle at least 7 percent of image width; no narrow enclosed ribbons. The walkway is especially wide and entirely white, with NO railing or side-thickness strip. No ground line and no sun or background detail. Keep the warm organic future-architecture character.

EDIT THE PROVIDED IMAGE ONLY. Keep both expressive organically curved future houses, their big windows/door, curving roof shapes, big central skybridge and the whole composition exactly. Remove the SECOND LOWER PARALLEL curve on the skybridge that makes a very thin underside ribbon; the bridge should have ONE broad blank white walkable shape bounded only by its top and bottom outer contours, with no narrow side edge. Also completely remove the small outlined circular DOORKNOB inside the lower left door, leaving that door blank white. Preserve all other professional linework. No added details, no new small areas, pure black on white.
visualReview: Accepted after inspecting both original PNG and all numbered region masks: expressive simple professional line art; major subject areas closed and separate from background; no narrow mechanical rings or omitted excess regions.
